posts.description: Since I wrote about writing Markdown in my patched COSMIC Text Editor , two releases came out. Version 0.6.0 gives the editor the search I used every day in Notepad++. Version 0.7.0 lets COSMIC Files show a folder’s own icon, so my projects folder finally looks like one. Both are part of Desktop Extras for COSMIC™, the collection of small tools from my first post .
